verdict.rationale: Postman documents 'Agent Mode' as a built-in AI assistant that lets users delegate tasks via natural language — sending requests, fixing errors, updating tests, writing documentation — plus Postbot as an AI assistant add-on with usage limits. This is first-party documentation but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration of real-world delegation quality. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Agent Mode's task delegation reliability, more detail on scope of tasks it can autonomously complete beyond docs' examples.
